thread:
Maya Lopez: quick heads-up — SampleApp onboarding broke after key rotation. CLI + Node SDK both fail with 401 during fetch to /v1/models.
Alex Chen: hmm, any logs? which env vars are being used in the sampleapp container?
Maya Lopez: logs show 'no api key found' in Node SDK. Container only had REDWOOD_API_KEY set (old name). Our new SDK patch expects RW_API_KEY first.
Samir Patel: oof. That mismatch is the root cause. We changed the canonical env var to RW_API_KEY in 2.0 but sampleapp was never updated.
Maya Lopez: exact. repro: docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=... sampleapp:latest -> fails. quick fix: export RW_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY
Alex Chen: we should make SDK tolerant for a migration period. Proposal: precedence order RW_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN -> RW_PROJECT_KEY. Also emit a one-time warn log when using deprecated names.
Claire Nguyen: agree. Also need to document project-scoped key behavior: project keys should only be used for local dev; server-side should use org keys. Docs + sampleapp should reflect that.
Samir Patel: for rotation we need support for key hot-reload: on 401, SDK will attempt to reload env sources once (exponential backoff on retries) before failing. Also add optional 'credential_provider' hook so integrators can fetch from vaults.
devex-bot: TEST FAIL — sampleapp/integration/auth-rotation test flaked on CI (run #4321).
Alex Chen: I'll own the SDK change. Plan: implement env fallback + deprecation warning + one-time telemetry event; add hot-reload on 401; tests + sampleapp update. ETA: PR today, ship in canary tomorrow, doc patch after.
Maya Lopez: sounds good. For the deprecation window let's do 90 days and announce in #announcements and changelog.
Claire Nguyen: also add migration notes to quickstart and a snippet: ```js
const key = process.env.RW_API_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: key });
```
Samir Patel: add e2e that sets only REDWOOD_API_KEY and rotates it mid-run.
Alex Chen: will do. @devex-bot please run auth-rotation e2e once PR lands :thumbsup: 
infra-bot: scheduled job auth-rotation-e2e queued by Alex Chen
Maya Lopez: thanks all — this should kill onboarding friction for new orgs.
